title: Terms of Service
content:
Effective date: 18 November 2026

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Leadership Course Abuja website and the services offered through it, including accounts, event registrations, donations and payments, volunteer and stall applications, newsletters and communications (together, the "Services"). By accessing or using the Services, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.

These Terms are between you and Leadership Course Abuja ("LCA", "we", "us", "our"). They should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms.

1. About us

Leadership Course Abuja is a youth-focused organisation that provides leadership development, events, resources, mentorship and community programmes. Our contact details are in section 18. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits any right you have under mandatory provisions of Nigerian law.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 13 years old to use the Services. If you are under 18, you may use account and registration features only with the consent and supervision of a parent or legal guardian, who agrees to these Terms on your behalf and is responsible for your use of the Services. We may ask for reasonable evidence of age or parental consent. If you are under 13, please do not create an account or use account features. We may refuse, suspend or terminate access if we reasonably believe you do not meet these requirements.

3. Your account

  • Accounts are created and managed through Clerk. You must provide accurate, current and complete information and keep it up to date.
  • You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us promptly if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.
  • You may not share your account, create multiple accounts to evade restrictions, or impersonate another person or organisation.
  • We may suspend or terminate your account if you breach these Terms, pose a security risk, misuse the Services, or where required by law. You may stop using the Services at any time and may ask us to delete your account, subject to our legal retention obligations and the Privacy Policy.

4. Events and RSVPs

  • An RSVP is a request to attend an event and is subject to capacity, confirmation, eligibility and event requirements. Submitting an RSVP does not guarantee admission.
  • You must provide accurate registration details. If guests are permitted, you are responsible for them and for ensuring they comply with these Terms and event rules.
  • Events may be changed, rescheduled, moved online or cancelled. We will take reasonable steps to notify registered attendees, but we do not guarantee that an event will proceed as advertised. Refunds, where applicable, are dealt with in section 5 or the specific event terms.
  • You must comply with our event code of conduct and all reasonable instructions from our team. We may refuse admission or remove anyone who is disruptive, unsafe, harassing, unlawful or otherwise unsuitable for the event.
  • We may photograph or record events for documentation and promotion. If you do not wish to appear in event media, please tell our event team or email us before or at the event. We will try to accommodate reasonable requests, but we cannot guarantee that you will not appear in crowd shots or background footage.

5. Donations and payments

  • Donations are voluntary. Online payments are processed by Paystack. You must be authorised to use the payment method you provide.
  • Paystack handles card and bank payment details. We do not receive or store full card numbers, CVV codes, PINs or banking passwords. We receive the transaction result and related details needed to record, verify and acknowledge your payment.
  • Amounts are charged in Nigerian naira (NGN) unless stated otherwise. You are responsible for any fees charged by your bank or payment provider.
  • Donations are generally non-refundable. If you believe a donation was made in error, was duplicated, was unauthorised, or the amount was incorrect, contact us within 14 days at legal@leadershipcourseabuja.org. We will review the request. Any refund is at our discretion, subject to Paystack's rules, applicable law and any transaction fees, and we may require proof of payment. We do not refund donations simply because you change your mind.
  • We may correct an amount, cancel a transaction or issue a refund if we identify a pricing or processing error.
  • We do not provide tax, legal or financial advice. Any acknowledgement or receipt we provide does not constitute tax advice. Please consult your own adviser.
  • If you ask to give anonymously, your name will not be shown publicly, but we may still process your details for records, fraud prevention and legal obligations.
  • If you reverse or dispute a payment without a valid reason, we may suspend your account and recover the amount, associated fees and reasonable costs.

6. Volunteer and stall applications

  • Submitting a volunteer or stall application does not guarantee selection, placement or a stall. We may accept or reject applications at our discretion based on suitability, capacity, event needs, compliance and community fit.
  • Stalls. Unless we agree otherwise, you may apply for one stall slot. Selected applicants will be contacted using the email address provided in the application. A payment link, where issued, is valid for 48 hours. If payment is not received within that period, the stall may be offered to another vendor, and a late payment will not secure a stall and may be treated as a charitable donation. Stall fees are non-refundable except where we cancel the event or the law requires a refund. You are responsible for complying with event rules, obtaining any licences or permits, and maintaining appropriate insurance for your products or services. We may relocate or withdraw a stall for safety, space or operational reasons.
  • Volunteering. Volunteering is unpaid and does not create an employment, agency or contractor relationship. Volunteers must complete any onboarding or safeguarding requirements and follow our policies and reasonable instructions. We may end a volunteer placement at any time.
  • You are responsible for the accuracy of your application and for ensuring that you have the rights to any content, images, logos or materials you submit.

7. Newsletter and communications

You may subscribe to our newsletter by providing your email address. By subscribing, you consent to receiving our newsletter and related updates. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in the email or by contacting us. We may still send service messages about your account, donations, payments, events or security. Do not subscribe another person without their consent. Newsletter submissions may be handled by Google Forms or Netlify Forms, depending on how the site is configured.

8. Acceptable use

You must use the Services lawfully and respectfully. You must not:

  • violate any applicable law, including the NDPA, or infringe the privacy, publicity or other rights of any person;
  • harass, threaten, defame, discriminate against or harm another person;
  • impersonate any person or misrepresent your affiliation with any person or organisation;
  • access, collect, disclose or use another person's account or personal data without permission;
  • scrape, crawl, harvest or use automated means to access the Services without our written permission;
  • introduce malware, overload or attack our systems, bypass security measures, or attempt to gain unauthorised access;
  • use the Services for spam, fraud, unauthorised commercial activity or misleading promotions;
  • infringe intellectual property rights; or
  • assist or encourage anyone to do any of the above.

We may investigate suspected misuse, remove content, report conduct to the relevant authorities, and suspend or terminate access.

9. Content and intellectual property

The website and its content, including text, graphics, logos, design, resources and software, are owned by or licensed to LCA and are protected by intellectual property laws. We grant you a limited, revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to access and use the Services for personal, non-commercial purposes in accordance with these Terms. You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, create derivative works from, publicly display or commercially exploit our content without our prior written permission. Third-party names and marks belong to their respective owners.

If you submit content, feedback or suggestions to us, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, reproduce, adapt and publish that material for the purpose of operating and promoting the Services. You confirm that you have the rights to grant this licence. We are not obliged to use any submission, and feedback may be used without compensation.

We respect intellectual property rights. If you believe content on the website infringes your rights, contact us at legal@leadershipcourseabuja.org with details.

10. Third-party services and links

The Services rely on third-party providers, including Clerk, Neon, Netlify, Paystack and Google. Their own terms and privacy policies apply to their services. The website may also contain links to third-party websites that we do not control. We are not responsible for third-party content, products, services or privacy practices, and you use them at your own risk.

11. Disclaimers

Content on the website is provided for general information and community purposes. It is not professional, legal, financial, medical or other advice, and you should not rely on it as such. Events, resources and other information may be incomplete, change or become out of date.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Services are provided "as is" and "as available". We disclaim all warranties, whether express or implied, including warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, non-infringement, accuracy, and uninterrupted, error-free or secure operation. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits any right or warranty that cannot be excluded or limited under Nigerian law.

12. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, or for loss of profits, revenue, data, goodwill or opportunity, arising out of or in connection with your use of the Services. Our total aggregate liability for direct damages arising out of or in connection with the Services is limited to the amount you paid to us, if any, in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim, or ₦25,000 if you paid nothing.

Nothing in these Terms limits or excludes our liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, death or personal injury caused by our negligence, or any other liability that cannot be limited or excluded by law. Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations, so some of the above may not apply to you.

To the extent permitted by law, you agree to indemnify and hold harmless LCA, its officers, employees, volunteers and agents from and against any claims, losses, liabilities, damages, costs and reasonable legal fees arising from your breach of these Terms, your misuse of the Services, or your violation of any law or third-party right. We may assume the defence of any matter subject to indemnity, and you agree to cooperate reasonably.

14. Privacy

Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share and protect personal data, and sets out your rights under the NDPA. It forms part of these Terms. By using the Services, you acknowledge that you have read the Privacy Policy.

15. Changes, suspension and termination

We may update these Terms from time to time. We will post the updated Terms on this page and update the effective date. Where a change is material, we will take reasonable steps to notify you, such as by email or a prominent notice on the website. Your continued use of the Services after the effective date means you accept the updated Terms.

We may suspend, restrict or terminate your access to the Services at any time if you breach these Terms, if we believe there is a security, legal or operational risk, or if we discontinue a service. Sections that by their nature should survive termination, including intellectual property, disclaimers, limitation of liability, indemnity and governing law, will continue to apply.

16. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Before starting court proceedings, the parties will try in good faith to resolve any dispute amicably by written notice to legal@leadershipcourseabuja.org. If the dispute is not resolved within 30 days, either party may bring proceedings in the courts of the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, subject to any mandatory consumer rights. Nothing in this section prevents either party from seeking urgent injunctive or other equitable relief, or from lodging a data protection complaint with the NDPC.

17. General

  • Entire agreement. These Terms, the Privacy Policy and any specific event, stall or payment terms we provide form the entire agreement between you and us regarding the Services.
  • Severability. If any provision is found invalid or unenforceable, it will be limited or removed to the minimum extent necessary, and the remaining provisions will continue in effect.
  • No waiver. Our failure or delay in enforcing a provision is not a waiver of our right to enforce it later.
  • Assignment. We may assign or transfer our rights and obligations to an affiliate or successor. You may not assign your rights or obligations without our written consent.
  • Force majeure. We are not liable for any delay or failure caused by events beyond our reasonable control, including network failures, power outages, natural disasters, industrial action or government action.
  • Language. These Terms are provided in English. Any translation is for convenience only, and the English version prevails.
